parts.name: Switch (Left Handle)
parts.Basic_description: This is the left handle switch of the faucet, made of stainless steel, used to control water flow or temperature.
parts.Functional_description: It rotates to open or close the water valve, typically controlling hot or cold water.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around its axis to adjust water flow.

parts.name: Switch (Right Handle)
parts.Basic_description: This is the right handle switch of the faucet, made of stainless steel, used to control water flow or temperature.
parts.Functional_description: It rotates to open or close the water valve, typically controlling hot or cold water.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around its axis to adjust water flow.

parts.name: Frame (Right Base)
parts.Basic_description: This is the right base frame of the faucet, made of brass, providing structural support for the right handle.
parts.Functional_description: It holds the right handle in place and connects it to the internal valve system.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and provides a stable mount for the handle.

parts.name: Frame (Left Base)
parts.Basic_description: This is the left base frame of the faucet, made of brass, providing structural support for the left handle.
parts.Functional_description: It holds the left handle in place and connects it to the internal valve system.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and provides a stable mount for the handle.

parts.name: Frame (Spout Base)
parts.Basic_description: This is the spout base frame of the faucet, made of brass, supporting the main spout structure.
parts.Functional_description: It connects the spout to the sink and provides a watertight seal.
parts.Movement_description: It remains fixed and supports the spout above the sink.

parts.name: Spout
parts.Basic_description: This is the spout of the faucet, made of stainless steel, through which water flows out.
parts.Functional_description: It directs the water flow from the internal plumbing to the sink basin.
parts.Movement_description: It may swivel horizontally to direct water flow to different areas of the sink.
